newsitem.title: USA: Harvard Industries gets $120 mln financing.
newsitem.headline: Harvard Industries gets $120 mln financing.

text.p: Harvard Industries Inc said Monday it has entered into a three-year, $120 million financing agreement with CIT Group/Business Credit Inc.
The aggregate line of credit consists of revolving loans and letters of credit of up to $90 million, and $30 million of term loans with a maturity date of Oct 4, 1999, it said.
The new financing agreement replaces the company's previous credit facility with Chase Manhattan Corp and other lenders. It refinanced all indebtedness outstanding, the company said.
Harvard Industries, through its subsidiaries, designs, develops and manufactures components for original-quipment manufacturers producing cars and light trucks.
